{{Top|leg}}
'''Center Sphere District''', sometimes known as '''Center Sphere''', was a district of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Bartyn's Landing]] on [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. It was the area of services, while the inhabitants lived in other points of the city. Center Sphere District owed its name to its position in the remains what had been the central orb of a [[LH-3010 capital freighter]] that had been dismantled to create the skeleton of the city.

==History==
Around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], [[Hugo Bartyn]], an agent of [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]], was assigned as [[Administrator (ORO)|Administrator]] of the [[Mining/Legends|mines]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. Bartyn had noticed that Lamaredd was also rich in seafood, and he intended to build a [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] town from which he could export the delicacies without any interference from ORO.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

Using his own savings, Bartyn bought a beat-up [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel]] [[LH-3010 capital freighter]] from some [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] and used mining equipment to blow up parts of it, creating the skeleton of the coastal town. The central command module was chosen to become the center of the city, and as such the top of it was destroyed.<ref name="BL" />

In the following centuries, the town, named [[Bartyn's Landing]], thrived. The "center of the city" was known as "Center Sphere District", or simply "Center Sphere", and locales there specialized in services. The situation continued for at least five centuries.<ref name="BL" />Anyone wanting to keep a good watch of what happened the city &mdash; such as the [[Security Chief (ORO)|Security Chief]] &mdash; was to be physically in the Sphere. As it was still a backwater town, markers pointing to Center Sphere were handwritten in walls.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

==Points of interest==
[[The Skylight Market]] was in the geographic center of the District, just under the open top, and its various stalls offered several kinds of products.<ref name="BL" /> Other services in the area included the media agency [[Center Sphere Flimsinews]]<ref name="BL" /> and the pub known as [[Tailfin Cantina]]. The most popular and busiest business in the District was the inn-and-something [[Miss Mylla's Saloon]],<ref name="BL" /><ref name="R" /> which was just in front of its direct competitor, [[The Even Cut Sabacc Parlor and Casino]].<ref name="BL" />

[[The Mighty Musstoro]], a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] wrestler, operated in the area, street-fighting for the wagers, but he did not have a physical locale.<ref name="R" /> The District was next to a docking area that was restricted to the use of locals. Part of this area was identified as [[Pier Green]].<ref name="R" /> A number of citizens performed Cargo Track races circling the District on the outer side.<ref name="BL" />
